cands.desc: The steel truss members of the Quebec Bridge, the cantilever bridge over the Saint Lawrence completed in 1917 after collapses in 1907 and 1916, whose 549 m central span is still the longest cantilever span in the world, against the clouds, in black and white. Quebec City, Quebec, Canada, August 2023
